weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入獅子座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往獅子座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，最近你經歷了很多事情。你有沒有花時間反思這一切？無論是在家庭還是在你的職業生活中，重大轉變可能即將到來。專注於當前的任務，而不是擔心超出您影響範圍的事情。你可能會覺得自己處於瘋狂的狀態，但請放心，事情很快就會平靜下來。花點時間眨眼，讓眼睛適應這種陌生的亮度。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, you've been through quite a lot lately. Have you taken the time to reflect on it all? Significant transformations may be on the horizon, whether at home or in your professional life. Concentrate on your current tasks instead of worrying about things beyond your influence. It might feel like you're on a wild ride, but rest assured, things will calm down soon. Take a moment to blink and let your eyes adjust to this unfamiliar brightness.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，最近幾週你看到了顯著的進步，尤其是在控制脾氣方面。這並不容易，但你正在學習在說話之前停頓。堅持你已經取得的進步。你的生活中有一個人似乎一心想觸動你的情緒。不要讓它們深入你的皮膚。相反，深吸一口氣，讓自己超越困境。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you've seen significant growth in recent weeks, particularly in managing your temper. It hasn't been easy, but you're learning to pause before you speak. Hold on to the progress you've made. There's someone in your life who seems intent on pushing your buttons. Don't allow them to get under your skin. Instead, take a deep breath and elevate yourself above the situation.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天對你來說可能是充滿活力的一天。那些與您關係密切的人，包括家人和朋友，可能會感到緊張，所以最好給他們一些空間。請放心，這不是您行為的反映；而是您的行為的反映。這只是行星的影響。如果你有機會躲到一個安靜的地方，那就抓住它。如果有人試圖激怒你，請克制住參與的衝動。明天將帶來新的視角和和諧的回歸。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today could be quite a charged day for you, Gemini. Those close to you, including family and friends, might be on edge, so it’s best to give them some space. Rest assured, it’s not a reflection of your actions; it’s just the influence of the planets. If you have the chance to retreat to a quiet spot, take it. Should anyone attempt to provoke you, resist the urge to engage. Tomorrow will bring a fresh perspective and a return to harmony.
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，當緊迫的事情再次出現，需要你的關注時，你可能會發現自己的心情有點憂鬱。雖然人們可能很容易忽略它們，但現在是時候正面面對這些問題並永久解決它們了。專注於在家中營造更令人振奮的氛圍，因為您的家人和朋友依靠您來帶頭培養積極性。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, you may find yourself in a bit of a somber mood as pressing matters resurface, demanding your attention. While it might be tempting to ignore them, it's time to confront these issues head-on and resolve them for good. Focus on creating a more uplifting atmosphere at home, as your family and friends rely on you to lead the way in fostering positivity.
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，現在不是施壓或壓力的時候。今天發揮作用的能量就像你平常一樣不屈不撓。目前的行星排列正在推動你邁出一步，將你的願望轉化為實際的成果，無論你是否準備好。是時候承認，雖然你已經制定策略很長一段時間了，但實際進展仍然有限。準備好換班吧！
leo.horoscope_en: Now is not the time to push or pressure, Leo. The energies at play today are just as unyielding as you tend to be. The current planetary alignments are nudging you to take the leap and transform your aspirations into tangible outcomes, whether you're ready or not. It's time to acknowledge that while you've been strategizing for quite a while, actual progress has been limited. Get ready for a shift!
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，你的生產力令人印象深刻，你的商業技巧也閃閃發光。然而，您可能會對目前的狀況感到不滿。當您審視周圍環境時，您可能會發現自己渴望為自己的努力獲得更切實的回報。擺脫這種心態很重要。真正的價值在於您培養的人際關係以及出色完成工作所帶來的滿足感。雖然新車或時尚服裝可能會暫時提升您的情緒，但請記住，這些只是表面層面的增強。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, your productivity is impressive, and your knack for business is shining through. Yet, you might be experiencing a sense of discontent with your current situation. As you survey your surroundings, you may find yourself longing for more tangible rewards for your efforts. It's important to steer clear of this mindset. True worth lies in the connections you nurture and the satisfaction that comes from a job well done. While a new vehicle or stylish attire might boost your mood temporarily, remember that these are merely surface-level enhancements.
virgo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你敏銳的分析能力是你職涯中的寶貴財富。然而，這種特質可能並不總是能很好地轉化為你的人際關係。似乎你所親愛的人可能會因為你缺乏敏感度而感到受傷。花點時間思考過去幾週發生的事情。您是否無意中傳達了被誤解的訊息？修正任何無意的冒犯。一句真誠的「我道歉」可以創造奇蹟。
libra.horoscope_en: Your sharp analytical skills have been a great asset in your professional endeavors, Libra. However, this trait may not always translate well into your personal relationships. It seems that someone dear to you may be feeling hurt by your perceived lack of sensitivity. Take a moment to ponder the happenings of the last few weeks. Could you have unintentionally conveyed a message that was misinterpreted? Make amends for any unintentional offenses. A heartfelt "I apologize" can work wonders.
libra.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，你的浪漫生活即將展開令人興奮的篇章。如果您與伴侶的關係最近感覺停滯不前，請做好轉變的準備。你們似乎都準備好迎接重大改變。無論是一起新的冒險還是更深層的承諾，可能性都令人興奮。相信你的直覺；它會引導你走向正確的道路。
scorpio.horoscope_en: A thrilling chapter is about to unfold in your romantic life, Scorpio. If your connection with your partner has felt stagnant recently, get ready for a shift. You both seem poised for a significant change. Whether it's a new adventure together or a deeper commitment, the possibilities are exciting. Trust your intuition; it will guide you toward the right path.
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 作為射手座，你的火熱精神是不可否認的。然而，當你周圍的人與你充滿活力的能量不匹配時，這可能會很有挑戰性。現在是時候稍微調整一下了。氣氛中有些摩擦，你平時的熱情可能會變得令人惱火，而不是討人喜歡。不要讓這讓你沮喪；這只是一個轉瞬即逝的階段。很快，你就會回到聚光燈下，帶給每個人關懷和溫暖。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: As a Sagittarius, your fiery spirit is undeniable. However, it can be challenging when those around you don't match your vibrant energy. Now is a moment to dial it back a bit. There's a bit of friction in the atmosphere, and your usual enthusiasm might come off as irritating instead of endearing. Don't let this get you down; it's just a fleeting phase. Soon enough, you'll be back in the spotlight, showering everyone with affection and warmth.
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 今天對你來說將會是非常強大的一天，摩羯座。一線希望是你會取得很大的成就。然而，請做好一天結束時可能感到疲勞的準備。明智地管理你的精力是明智的。專注於真正重要的事情，避免因次要細節而分心。透過專注於更大的目標，較小的問題自然會迎刃而解。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today promises to be quite a powerful day for you, Capricorn. The silver lining is that you'll achieve a great deal. However, be prepared for potential fatigue by day's end. It's wise to manage your energy wisely. Concentrate on what truly matters and avoid getting sidetracked by minor details. By keeping your eyes on the larger goals, the smaller issues will naturally fall into place.
capricorn.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今天的重點是維護自己的獨立性並相信自己的判斷。雖然您可能傾向於依賴他人尋求指導，但請記住您的見解是最可靠的。如果你太專注於別人如何回應你的選擇，你可能會發現自己陷入優柔寡斷的境地。您清楚地了解什麼是適合您的，並根據您的信念採取行動最終將使您周圍的每個人受益。現在不是不確定的時刻——接受你的決定並充滿信心地前進！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, today is all about asserting your independence and trusting your own judgment. While you may have a tendency to lean on others for guidance, remember that your insights are the most reliable. If you focus too much on how others might respond to your choices, you could find yourself stuck in indecision. You have a clear understanding of what’s right for you, and taking action based on your convictions will ultimately benefit everyone around you. Now is not the moment for uncertainty—embrace your decisions and move forward with confidence!
aquarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

pisces.horoscope: 身為雙魚座，你的夢想本性受到周遭人的珍惜。然而，今天的宇宙能量需要採取更接地氣的方法。解決一些需要你關注的個人事務很重要，而不是迷失在白日夢中。現在是優先考慮你所愛的人的時候了，因為他們可能會感到被忽視。採取必要的步驟，向您的家人表明您隨時準備以他們需要的任何方式支持他們。
pisces.horoscope_en: As a Pisces, your dreamy nature is cherished by those around you. However, the cosmic energies today call for a more grounded approach. It's essential to address some personal matters that require your attention, rather than getting lost in daydreams. Now is the moment to prioritize your loved ones, as they may be feeling overlooked. Take the necessary steps to show your family that you're present and ready to support them in any way they need.
